roadmap.goal: ADO Epic 6400 'Fast with many Features'. Six Stories, delivered one at a time, each releasable alone. The phases array holds DESIGN DDD-3's default order for pool starvation alone (01, 03, 04, 02, 05, 06); the D27 re-score in step 01-05 fixes the order of 02, 03 and 05, and DELIVER follows it. 01 (#6404, with Task #6405): a dev-only measuring harness first records the baseline and classifies the stalls; only if they come from the shared thread pool does a background forecast round then run on a dedicated ForecastLane, with the size band `featuresHeld` on the two tab-opened events. 03 (#6407): the Features tab's existing reads leave out the histograms they do not show, and a reference id stored twice answers rather than 500s. 04 (#6408): one owner-keyed Features list per Portfolio and Team, with loading, failure, empty and all-hidden looks. 02 (#6406): the Overview, the detail pages and Settings read names and counts without forecasts, and the licence gates share one query and refuse creation while the licence cannot be told. 05 (#6409): forecast rounds gather without histograms and write back from their own read. 06 (#6410): a Portfolio over 100 Features says so on its edit page and in the log. The invariant every step keeps: the answer does not change, only the work behind it. Every golden body, verdict, position, forecast and fingerprint stays identical. Done when all 67 pending backend cases and all 53 pending frontend cases are un-skipped and green, the walking skeleton and the 27 active guards stay green, PendingEpic6400 is deleted, no SCAFFOLD stub is left in the frontend, `dotnet build` has zero warnings, the filtered `dotnet test` is green, and `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` are clean. Docs, screenshots, release notes and mutation runs belong to finalization. They are NOT steps here.
